info.title: Tatame API
info.description: Identity (spec 001-auth), enrollment (spec 003) and attendance (spec 004) surfaces. Errors are RFC 9457 application/problem+json with stable `code`s. The live-chamada SSE stream is a documented exception to the generated REST contract: its event payloads are component schemas, but clients wire their own streaming primitive.
